BiblicalUsage: A bough is a cut branch, and Abimelech turns it into a weapon. He cuts down a bough from the trees and lays it on his shoulder, and all the people do the same, piling the boughs against the hold of Shechem and setting it on fire, so that about a thousand men and women die.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the boughs show how quickly a crowd follows a cruel leader, and the fire they carried came back on them all.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
